summary: First round of testing on Gestão Financeira Familiar. Backend 22/22 pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, analytics, budget, alerts, calendar, transactions CRUD + recurrence + pay, generic CRUD for categories/accounts/tasks/reminders/notes/opportunities/goals, settings). Frontend UI login via casal@financas.com/familia123 navigates to Dashboard correctly. All 12 dashboard cards, health banner (positive) and 2 Recharts charts render. Nav to all 14 sections works. CRUD for tasks/notes/reminders/goals via UI verified. Marking Conta a Pagar as paid immediately updates Dashboard (contas_pendentes 2245→795, contas_pagas 3310→4760). Global filters (month/year/person) render. Logout via user-menu → logout-btn works and returns to login screen.

issues: Uses native browser date/time picker (input type=date/time) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component — inconsistent with rest of design system
logout is nested inside user-menu dropdown (correct behavior) but playbook lists logout-btn as top-level; test scripts must first click user-menu

action_items: (optional/design) Consider replacing native HTML date/time inputs with shadcn Calendar/Popover to maintain consistent dark-theme UX across Tarefas, Lembretes and Transações forms.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~860 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers/models/services modules for maintainability.

CORS: allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL + '*'. Combining '*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec — browsers will refuse credentialed CORS. Currently works because auth also accepts Bearer header from localStorage, but cookie-based auth cross-origin may silently fail. Prefer explicit origin list without '*'.
Dashboard 'contas_pendentes' logic mixes vencimento-in-month with a global '>= today' fallback; could over-count items with vencimento in future months.
Generic CRUD register_crud lacks 404 handling on POST create when validation fails at Pydantic level (fine) and lacks GET-by-id endpoint (not used by UI — OK).
Startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan.
Data are shared globally (no workspace_id column) — expected per spec (single casal workspace), but hardcoded implicit assumption; documenting it is fine.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed_demo already seeds demo transactions/goals/opportunities/tasks/notes/reminders on empty DB. Tests create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav data-testids use lowercase kebab-case with Portuguese accents preserved (e.g. nav-saídas, nav-gráficos, nav-relatórios, nav-configurações). Logout is inside user-menu dropdown: click [data-testid=user-menu] first then [data-testid=logout-btn]. Modal forms for Tarefa/Nota/Lembrete/Meta lack placeholders on 'Título' inputs — use dialog.locator('input').first to fill title. Backend endpoints are all under /api and support both httpOnly cookie and Bearer token.
